versions.subject: feat: update and fixes
versions.detection:
selection_pe:
    - Image|endswith:
        - \Sysmon64.exe
        - \Sysmon.exe
    - Description: 'System activity monitor'
selection_cli:
    CommandLine|contains:
        - '-c'
        - '/c'
condition: all of selection_*
versions.spl: Image IN ("*\\Sysmon64.exe", "*\\Sysmon.exe") OR Description="System activity monitor" CommandLine IN ("*-c*", "*/c*")
